why: Petrol, diesel and LPG pink slips

qa.q: How much is a pink slip?
qa.also: pink slip cost, price, fee, how much, rego check price, safety check cost, e-safety, esafety, pnk slip, pink slp, prise, pinkslip, how much pinkslip
qa.a: The NSW Government sets the most any station can charge for a car: $52 for a pink slip, from 1 July 2026. If it doesn't pass and is fixed and checked again here within 14 days, there's no second inspection fee.

qa.q: How much is a blue slip?
qa.also: blue slip cost, price, fee, AUVIS, identity check cost
qa.a: The most a station can charge for a blue slip on a car is $82, set by the NSW Government from 1 July 2026.

qa.q: What is a pink slip?
qa.also: pink slip, rego check, safety check, esafety, inspection, renew rego, do I need a pink slip
qa.a: A pink slip is the safety check most light vehicles need to renew their rego once they're more than five years old, counted from the compliance plate date. It checks things like tyres, brakes, steering and suspension, lights, windscreen and wipers, seatbelts, body and rust, and the exhaust. The report is valid for six months.

qa.q: Do I need a blue slip?
qa.also: blue slip, unregistered, interstate car, expired rego, no plates, written off, register a car in NSW, identity check, queensland, qld, victoria, vic, interstate car, from another state, moving to nsw, bought a car from
qa.a: You need a blue slip, a safety and identity check, when the rego ran out more than three months ago, the vehicle comes from interstate or overseas, it has no plates, or it's a written-off vehicle being registered again. The report is valid for 42 days.

qa.q: Does a new car need a pink slip?
qa.also: under 5 years, new car rego, 3 year old car, no inspection
qa.a: Cars up to five years old usually renew their rego without an inspection. Your renewal notice says whether you need one. A logbook service is still worth booking.

qa.q: Do you do pink slips for LPG and diesel cars?
qa.also: lpg, gas car, diesel, petrol, dual fuel
qa.a: We do pink slips for petrol, diesel and LPG vehicles.

qa.q: What happens if my car fails the pink slip?
qa.also: fail, failed, didn't pass, recheck, re-inspection, fix and recheck
qa.a: We'll tell you what failed. It needs to be fixed before it can pass. If it's fixed and checked again here within 14 days, there's no second inspection fee, and we can do the repairs in the workshop.

qa.q: What are your opening hours?
qa.also: hours, open, opening times, when are you open, close, closing time, today, weekdays
qa.a: Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, Saturday 9am to 2pm. We're closed on Sundays.

qa.q: Are you open on Saturday?
qa.also: saturday, weekend
qa.a: Saturday 9am to 2pm.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.also: sunday
qa.a: No, we're closed on Sundays. We're open Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm and Saturday 9am to 2pm.

qa.q: Do you do logbook services?
qa.also: logbook, service, car service, scheduled service, oil change, service book

qa.q: Can you fix my air con?

qa.q: Can you replace my battery?
qa.also: battery, flat battery, won't start, car won't start, jump start

qa.q: Do you fix brakes?
qa.also: brakes, squealing, grinding, pads, rotors, brake noise, suspension, steering

qa.q: What does the warning light on my dash mean?
qa.also: warning light, dash light, check engine light, engine light, battery light, oil light, abs light, light on
qa.a: Tap the light you can see in the warning lights section for what it usually means and whether to keep driving. As a rule of thumb, red usually means stop when it's safe, and amber means get it checked soon.

qa.q: My check engine light is on
qa.also: check engine light, engine light, engine light flashing, engine warning light, orange engine light
qa.a: Check engine is an amber light: get it checked soon. If it stays on steadily, you can usually drive on gently and book it in soon. If it flashes, the engine may be misfiring badly: slow down, stop somewhere safe as soon as you can and call. General guidance only; your owner's manual has the details for your car.

qa.q: My oil light came on
qa.also: oil light, oil pressure light, oil warning, oil can light
qa.a: Oil pressure is a red light: stop as soon as it's safe and switch the engine off. An engine without oil pressure can be damaged quickly. Check the oil level once it has cooled, and call before driving on.

qa.q: My battery light is on
qa.also: battery light, charging light, alternator light
qa.a: Battery or charging is a red light. The car is running on what's left in the battery and may stop. Switch off what you don't need, like the air con and radio, and get somewhere safe. If other lights come on too, stop.

qa.q: My brake warning light is on
qa.also: brake light on dash, brake warning, handbrake light, park brake light
qa.a: Brake system is a red light. Check the park brake first. If the light stays on, stop somewhere safe and don't drive on until the brakes have been checked.

qa.q: My engine temperature light is on
qa.also: temperature light, overheating, temp gauge high, engine hot, coolant light, steam
qa.a: Engine temperature is a red light: stop as soon as it's safe and switch off. Let the engine cool, and never open the radiator cap while it's hot. Call before driving on.

qa.q: Is a pink slip expensive?
qa.also: expensive, cheap, cheapest, dear, cost a lot, worth it, rip off
qa.a: The price is not set by us: the NSW Government caps a pink slip for a car at $52, from 1 July 2026. If it doesn't pass and is fixed and checked again here within 14 days, there's no second inspection fee.

qa.q: How long is a pink slip valid?
qa.also: pink slip valid, pink slip expiry, how long does a pink slip last, pink slip good for
qa.a: A pink slip report is valid for six months.

qa.q: How long is a blue slip valid?
qa.also: blue slip valid, blue slip expiry, how long does a blue slip last
qa.a: A blue slip report is valid for 42 days.

qa.q: Do LPG cars need anything extra for a pink slip?
qa.also: lpg extra, lpg tank, gas system check, lpg inspection
qa.a: On LPG cars the pink slip also checks the gas system: the tank, lines and fittings. We do pink slips for petrol, diesel and LPG vehicles.

qa.q: Do you service electric cars?
qa.also: electric car, ev, tesla, byd, hybrid battery, electric vehicle, plug in
qa.a: Electric vehicle servicing is not listed on our website. Call the workshop to check before you book.
